verified_facts.claim: ₱5 million was allegedly spent on a coordinated online campaign
verified_facts.finding: Multiple sources confirm that ₱5 million was allegedly spent on a coordinated online campaign, specifically one using misleading content about La Union flooding. The claim is attributed to Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V of La Union, who made this allegation regarding a coordinated campaign that used misleading photographs and videos.

verified_facts.claim: The campaign used misleading photographs and videos about La Union flooding
verified_facts.finding: Multiple news sources confirm that an online campaign used misleading photographs and videos about La Union flooding. Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V publicly condemned the spread of fake, exaggerated, and spliced videos and photos depicting flooding conditions in La Union, alleging P5 million was spent on this coordinated campaign to portray flooding as worse than actual conditions.

verified_facts.claim: The content portrayed flooding as far worse than reality
verified_facts.finding: The search results do not contain any information relevant to evaluating this claim. The results discuss AI-generated content flooding social media and children's media, and references to 'the Flood' from the Halo video game series. None of these results address any content that portrayed flooding (as in water flooding) as worse than reality.

disputed_claims.claim: La Union flooding severity was deliberately misrepresented through coordinated campaign
disputed_claims.competing_accounts: Source presents Ortega's characterization as misleading content; no counter-narrative from campaign operators documented in source material

competing_frames.summary: A ₱5 million coordinated effort deliberately used misleading visual content to exaggerate La Union flooding severity for undisclosed purposes
